text_markup: If the choice is only referred to by another lingering effect, the lingering effect maintaining the choice has the same duration as the other lingering effect.
text_plain: If the choice is only referred to by another lingering effect, the lingering effect maintaining the choice has the same duration as the other lingering effect.

examples.text_markup: The Runner resolves {card:Pelangi}'s paid ability and chooses an ice subtype. The ability then creates a lingering effect adding the chosen subtype to the encountered ice. Both the choice of subtype and the effect adding it to the ice expire at the end of the encounter.
